questions.text: What are the differences between the static and dynamic economy?
questions.text_as_printed: What are the differences between the static and dynamic economy? (D)

answer.value:
Static vs. Dynamic Economy:
Static Economy:
Derived from the Greek word "Statike," meaning to stand still.
Refers to an economy with no changes.
Timeless, with no economic growth.
Economic components remain unchanged.
Dynamic Economy:
Derived from the Greek word "Dynamikos," meaning powerful change.
Studies continuous changes in the economy over time.
Economic components constantly evolve.
Economic growth varies year to year.

questions.text: Draw a diagram showing the flow of sources of income and identify its main factors.
questions.text_as_printed: Draw a diagram showing the flow of sources of income and identify its main factors. (D)

answer.value:
Interactions in a Simple Economy:
Household and industrial units are interdependent.
